title: Numerically Stable Softmax for a List

references.label: Original Luma AI MLE assessment report
Independent Luma AI MLE assessment report — softmax corroboration

prompt:
A model produces a list of logits that must be converted into probabilities. Implement `softmax(logits)` and return a list in the same order. For each logit xᵢ, its probability is `exp(xᵢ) / sum(exp(xⱼ))` over all inputs. The result must remain finite and normalized even when the logits have large magnitudes.

The input is a nonempty list of finite numbers. You may use `math.exp`; do not use NumPy or PyTorch. Leave the input unchanged.
